runs.t: Eight months, read from the paper.

notes:
Seedha shuru. Prelims 23 May 2027 ko hai. Aaj se 226 din, matlab 32 hafte.
Aaj main koi motivational plan nahi de rahi. Yeh plan UPSC ke 19 saal ke paper se nikla hai. Har hafte kya, kitna, aur kab test, sab number ke saath.

Yeh teen questions dekho. 2021 me Right to Privacy kis Article me. 2024 me phir wahi. 2026 me Article 13 me law ki definition, X aur Y ka seminar.
Ek hi microtheme, teen paper. UPSC naya topic nahi dhoondhta, wahi theme naye angle se poochta hai. Is plan ki neev yahi hai.

Toh yeh plan kis cheez pe khada hai. 2008 se 2026 tak ke 1,994 prelims questions, har ek ek microtheme se tagged. 12 subjects, 209 microthemes.
Yeh hamara apna question map hai. Jo bhi main aaj bolungi, yahin se aa raha hai. Andaza nahi, ginti.

runs.t: Plan for 105, not for one year's cut-off.

notes:
Cut-off dekho. 2023 me 75. 2025 me 92.66. 2026 ka estimate 79 ke aas paas.
17 marks ka swing. Iska matlab: kisi saal ke cut-off ke liye plan mat banao. 105 se upar ka target rakho, tab har saal safe ho.

notes: Part one. Kitaab kholne se pehle paper padhna hai. Paper kya kar raha hai, kis subject ko badha raha hai, kisko chhod raha hai, aur format kaise badal raha hai.

notes:

HOW-MANY AND STATEMENT I/II QUESTIONS, SHARE OF PAPER

notes:
Ab format. Kitne questions 'how many of the above' ya Statement I aur II wale the. 2021 tak zero. 2023 me 65 percent. 2024 me 31, 2025 me 41. 2026 me sirf 5.
Format har saal badalta hai. Hum sabse kathin wale ke liye taiyari karenge, kyunki usme aadha gyaan zero deta hai.

runs.t: PART 1 · WHAT THE PAPER IS DOING
to the statement, not the chapter.

notes:
Yeh kyun maayne rakhta hai. Purane format me agar aap teen me se do statement jaante the, toh options se answer nikal jaata tha.
How many wale format me chaar me se teen sahi pata hai, phir bhi marks zero. Isliye is plan me har microtheme statement level tak jaayega, chapter level tak nahi.

dot size = how hard the questions are

notes:
Ab sabse kaam ka chart. X axis pe padhne ki mehnat, Y axis pe har paper me kitne questions. Gola jitna bada, question utna kathin.
Polity: kam mehnat, 12 questions har saal. Governance aur Modern History bhi kam mehnat wale. Economy, Sci-Tech, Art and Culture: zyada mehnat, zyada kathin. Pehle peele wale band karo.

HARD IS NOT THE SAME AS HEAVY

notes:
Yeh difficulty ka data bhi tool me hai. Economy: question difficulty very high, learning bhi very high. Polity: questions high, lekin learning moderate, kyunki syllabus band hai.
Economy ko zyada din, Polity ko kam din, par Polity ko pehle.

notes:
Isliye maine microthemes ko paanch dabbon me baanta. HOT: 29 microthemes, baar baar aaye aur abhi bhi badh rahe, pichhle 5 saal ke 41 percent questions.
STEADY 38, WARM 67, THIN 75 jinse kul 4 se kam questions aaye, aur COOLED 17 jo 2020 ke baad chup hain. Har dabbe ka revision alag hoga.

THE HOT TWENTY · DOTS ARE 2022 TO 2026

notes:
Yeh hain top 20 HOT microthemes. United Nations aur agencies, map based world geography, conflict zones, defence, pollution sources, environment treaties.
Har line ke saath 5 dot, 2022 se 2026. Bada dot matlab us saal zyada questions. Yeh list aapke pehle 10 hafte ki list hai.

runs.t: PART 1 · WHAT THE PAPER IS DOING

notes:
Aur yeh 17 COOLED microthemes. National Parks, Ecological Theory, National Income, Five Year Plans, Census. Kabhi heavy the, ab chup hain.
Inhe chhodna nahi hai, UPSC wapas la sakta hai. Lekin inhe ek line ka revision milega, poora chapter nahi.
Part two. Material. Chaar documents: Microthemes, Flash Notes, X-Factor Notes aur Burning Issues. Har naya PDF jo Telegram pe aata hai, us se microtheme band nahi hota.

Microthemes document. Ek subject, khula hua. Polity me 33 microthemes, har ek ke saamne kitne questions. Fundamental Rights 21, Political Theory 21, Judiciary 19.
Aur andar har microtheme ke saare purane questions. Padhai yahin se shuru hoti hai.

Flash Notes. Chapter ka woh hissa jo poocha gaya hai, table me. Ancient literature, Buddhist texts, Sanskrit poets: author, kitaab, kyun important.
Prelims ka revision isi se hoga, kyunki statement ka sach ek line me milta hai.

runs.t: THE CHAPTER, AND THE FLASH NOTE

notes:
Fundamental Rights ka chapter 33 page ka hai. Flash Note 4 page ka. Jo hata woh kabhi poocha hi nahi gaya.
Pehli reading chapter se, uske baad har revision 4 page se. Isi se 8 baar revision possible hota hai.

X-Factor Notes. Yeh mains ke liye bane hain, par prelims me inka kaam hai numbers aur reports. Kaunsi committee, kaunsa index, kaunsa data.
Statement questions me yahi number ek option ko kaat deta hai.

Current affairs. Burning Issues mahine ki compilation hai, issue ke hisaab se, date ke hisaab se nahi. Har issue ek microtheme pe baithta hai.
Naya notebook nahi. Jo khabar aayi, us microtheme ke page pe ek line.
Part three. Ab plan. 32 hafte, paanch phase, har phase ki taarikh.

Poora plan ek screen pe. A: 12 October se 20 December, hot core band. B: 21 December se 31 January, warm microthemes aur khabar ka map. C: February March, pehla test season. D: April se 10 May, doosra test season. E: 11 se 22 May, taper.
Screenshot le lo.

Phase A. 10 hafte. HOT aur STEADY milake 67 microthemes. Har hafte 6 se 7.
Ek heavy microtheme ko 5 ghante. 67 guna 5, lagbhag 335 ghante. 10 hafte, 6 din, 6 ghante: 360. Fit hai.
Order tool deta hai: sabse zyada questions, sabse recent, pehle.

Ek microtheme ka loop. Pehle uske purane questions, kitaab baad me. Phir flash note. Phir apna one pager. Phir 25 MCQs.
Aur phir woh tool me 'learning' mark hota hai, teesre din wapas aata hai, phir dasve din, phir tees din baad.

runs.t: Sunday is a test and an error log,

notes:
Phase A ka ek hafta. Monday se Saturday: 3 ghante microtheme, 1 ghanta revision queue, 1 ghanta current affairs, 1 ghanta us din ke MCQs. Sunday test aur error log.
Right side tool ka auto-fill hai. Har din 4 microthemes, heaviest pehle.

runs.t: WHAT A CLOSED MICROTHEME LOOKS LIKE

notes:
Microtheme band kab maana jaaye? Jab us ka ek page ho, apne haath ka. Yeh asli topper pages hain. Koi paragraph nahi, boxes, arrows, map.
Mai me aap 209 microthemes ke liye 4 page ki kitaab nahi padhoge. Yeh pages padhoge.

Phase B. 21 December se 31 January, 6 hafte. WARM wale 67 microthemes, har ek ko dhai ghanta.
Saath me 2026 ki saari khabar microthemes pe map karo, Burning Issues ke saath. Aur purane paper shuru, timed.

runs.t: FOURTEEN OLD PAPERS, ON THE CLOCK
Every wrong answer is tagged to its microtheme.

notes:
Purane paper. 2013 se 2026, 14 paper. December aur January me, har teesre din ek. Asli 2 ghante, asli time.
Score note karo, aur har galat answer ko microtheme se jodo. Yahi aapka pehla error log banega.

runs.t: one line each. CSAT three sets a week.

notes:
Phase C. February March, 8 hafte. Har hafte ek full test, do sectional. Saath me THIN aur COOLED microthemes, ek ek line.
CSAT ab hafte me teen set. Har test ke baad mentor ya khud, error log zaroor.

Phase D. April se 10 May. Hafte me do full test, aur exam wale clock pe: 9:30 baje. Phir 2 ghante marking aur error log, phir revision queue, shaam ko CSAT.
Dimag ko ghadi bhi yaad karni hai, sirf paper nahi.
Aakhri 12 din. Kuch naya nahi. 12, 15 aur 18 May ko teen test. Baaki din sirf one pagers aur error log. 22 May ko neend, syllabus nahi.

runs.t: EVERY SITTING BEFORE THE REAL ONE

notes:
Test kitne. October se May: 32 sectional, 14 purane paper, 23 full test. 69 baar baithna, asli din se pehle.
Jo log fail hote hain unka problem padhai kam nahi hoti, test kam hote hain.

notes:
Revision ka niyam tool me bana hua hai. Jo microtheme aapne 'learning' mark kiya, woh teesre din wapas aata hai. 'Revised' mark kiya, toh 10 din baad. 'Confident', toh 30 din baad.
Har baar sahi nikla, gap badhta hai. Galat nikla, wapas learning.

Aur roz kya revise karna hai, woh order bhi formula se aata hai. Microtheme ke past questions, plus 7 agar pichhle 2 saal me aaya, plus 3 agar pichhle 5 saal me.
Isliye tool ki Today wali list kabhi mood se nahi banti. Sabse bhaari, sabse recent, pehle.

runs.t: PART 4 · REVISION THAT DOES NOT LEAK
REVISIONS EACH TIER GETS BY 23 MAY
Revision time follows the questions too.

notes:
Iska nateeja. 23 May tak HOT microthemes 8 baar revise honge, STEADY 6 baar, WARM 4, THIN 2, COOLED ek baar.
Revision ka time bhi questions ke hisaab se baanta gaya hai, barabar nahi.

runs.t: PART 4 · REVISION THAT DOES NOT LEAK

notes:
Aur revise kya karna hai: jo poocha gaya. Hamari annotated NCERT me hara matlab yahan se question aaya hai.
Doosri baar padhte waqt sirf hara padho, aur uske aas paas ka. Isi tarah 8 revision 8 hafte nahi lete.
Part five. Test kaise dena hai. Test marks dekhne ke liye nahi, galti pakadne ke liye hota hai.

Yeh maths dekho. Ek sahi pe 2, ek galat pe minus do tihai. 80 questions attempt, 65 percent sahi: 85 marks. Wahi 80, 75 percent sahi: 107.
10 percent accuracy, 21 marks. Yahi farak cut-off ke neeche aur upar ka hai. Attempt badhana nahi, accuracy badhani hai.

Kab guess karna hai. Ek bhi option nahi kata: expected zero, chhod do. Ek kata: thoda sa plus, sirf agar cut pe pakka bharosa ho. Do kat gaye: plus 0.67, zaroor attempt karo.
Yeh rule har test me lagao, taaki exam me sochna na pade.

runs.t: Thirty minutes after every test, sorting each wrong answer
into one of four boxes, is worth more than the test.

notes:
Har galat answer chaar me se ek dabbe me jaata hai. Pata nahi tha: wapas microtheme queue me. Pata tha, galat padha: 'not', 'only', 'all' pe dhimiyaa. Galat option kaata: trap ka naam likho. Guess kiya, haara: attempt rule tight karo.
Test ke baad yeh 30 minute, test se zyada keemti hain.

runs.t: WHERE YOUR MOCK SCORES SHOULD SIT

notes:
Mock score kya hona chahiye. February me 80 ke aas paas theek hai. March me 95. April me 108. May me 115.
Agar April ke end tak 100 cross nahi hua, toh nayi padhai rok do, sirf HOT microthemes aur error log.

runs.t: THE PAPER PEOPLE THINK IS EASY

notes:
CSAT. 200 me se 66 chahiye, bas. Lekin har saal achhe GS wale yahin gir jaate hain.
December January hafte me do set, February March teen, April May roz ek ghanta. Isko aakhri mahine pe mat chhodo.

22 May ki raat aap ke paas kya hoga. 67 heavy microthemes, 6 se 8 baar revise. 37 poore paper, 14 purane aur 23 full test. Aur ek error log jisme har galti ka naam hai.
Yeh confidence motivation se nahi, ginti se aata hai.

Aaj ka saara data free hai. Microthemes document aur yeh question map, dono. Google pe Civilsdaily microthemes search karo.
Iske bina yeh plan andaze pe chalega.
